name: madrasha
description: Root runner + npm workspace root for landing/admin/frontend/super-admin (backend stays a separate npm project)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,LANDING,ADMIN,FRONTEND,SUPER-ADMIN -c blue,green,yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --workspace=landing" "npm run dev --workspace=admin" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=super-admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --workspace=landing && npm run build --workspace=admin && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=super-admin
